name: THE POLICE STATION
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: An area command station is a public lobby behind a counter of bullet-resistant glass, the squad room of desks behind it, holding cells along a corridor, the evidence and property cages, and the sally port: the secured garage where the patrol cars pull in and prisoners are walked out.
A holding cell is block and bars, about the size of a parking space; a sally port is a garage with a door at each end.
On house tiles a row of holding cells is a wall you see through the bars of; a patrol car is cover beside it, low enough to see over.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (police_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The police station is its own map kind: eight fights in ten there are fought inside it, by the cell's own dice; the rest in its lot.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words); 'sight' says whether a blocker hides a man ('blocked', the obstacles row) or is seen past ('seen'). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The station's block wall: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The station's floor: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

cells.effect: A holding cell's front of bars: nobody passes; you see through the bars; cover beside it. [bb] its palisade you see through.

bunk.effect: A cell's steel bunk, bolted down: low cover.

desks.effect: Squad room desks pushed together: cover.

boxes.effect: Case boxes spilled across the floor, the files fanned out: low cover, and slow going (3 AP). [bb] its brush.
boxes.say: Spilled case boxes: low cover, slow going.

counter.effect: The front counter, built to stop a bullet: cover.

glass.effect: The lobby's bullet-resistant glass, starred and holding: nobody passes; you see through it; cover beside it. [bb] its wall you see over.

chairs.effect: Lobby chairs bolted in a row: low cover.

lockers.effect: A bank of officers' lockers, a man's height: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

evidence.effect: The evidence cage, its mesh cut and its shelves bare: nobody passes; you see through the mesh; cover beside it. [bb] its palisade you see through.

cages.effect: The property cages along the sally port's wall, mesh: nobody passes; you see through it; cover beside it. [bb] its palisade you see through.

car.effect: A patrol car on flat tires, its light bar dead: nobody stands there; low enough to see over; cover beside it. [bb] its boulder.

cones.effect: Traffic cones and stands heaped: low cover.

barrier.effect: A water-filled barrier, emptied and dragged in: cover.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a drum. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The station's doors, the sally port's roll-up, open: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in police_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: one floor; the cars' roofs are not a place to stand on house tiles.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the squad room's dropped ceiling and the sally port's roof deck, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the hospital's grid).
